status: layout specification; not a finished renderer or layered artwork master

canvas.coordinate_system: Reference pixel boxes below; scale x by 1080/1122 and y by 1350/1402

approved_overrides.compass: center actual mark alone in upper-right reserved box; remove words below it
approved_overrides.data: Replace all reference numbers, dates, text, ranks and opponent with card JSON values

fixed_art_direction.paper: Warm aged parchment; preserve reference grain and distressed outer ink border
fixed_art_direction.masthead: Distressed team-primary painted panel, cream condensed athletic city and large nickname; verified team emblem only
fixed_art_direction.metric_bands: Three equal outlined full-width bands; numbered secondary-color tiles; distressed black labels; large net values; right rank badges; tilted distressed rank stamp
fixed_art_direction.typography: Match reference athletic block display and typewriter body; exact original font names unavailable, do not claim supplied substitutes are identical

content_fit_rules: Reference measurements are explicit production targets; fit must be checked in the chosen renderer
Do not compress text horizontally or clip
Shorten meaning to fit before reducing below readable size
Stamp must not collide with arithmetic or meaning
Keep negatives signed; percentage points fully spelled out

stamp_policy.basis: Current descriptive NFL rank out of 32; not a talent or confidence rating

release_gate: Compare against bundled reference before approval
Check three representative renders at phone size
No claim of exact visual reproduction until inspected
